Title: Login modal opens from the header
Preconditions: User is on the home page, logged out
Test Steps:
1. Open https://www.demoblaze.com/
2. Click 'Log in' in the header
Expected Result: The 'Log in' modal opens showing Username and Password fields, plus Close and Log in buttons
Automation Reference: tests/ui/login/login.spec.ts › logs in with valid credentials

Title: Log in with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Open the home page
2. Click 'Log in'
3. Enter a valid username
4. Enter the matching password
5. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Modal closes, header shows 'Welcome <username>', 'Log out' is visible and 'Log in' / 'Sign up' are hidden
Automation Reference: tests/ui/login/login.spec.ts › logs in with valid credentials

Title: Error wording reveals whether an account exists
Preconditions: One registered account exists and one username does not
Test Steps:
1. Attempt login with a valid username and wrong password
2. Attempt login with a username that does not exist
Test Data:
case 1: <valid user> / wrong
case 2: ghost_9f2a1c / any
Expected Result: The two attempts return different messages ('Wrong password.' vs 'User does not exist.'), which allows username enumeration. Raised as DEMO-5; expected behaviour is a single generic message
Automation Reference: tests/ui/login/login.negative.spec.ts › does not leak whether an account exists through timing or wording

Title: Repeated failed logins are not rate-limited or locked out

Automation Reference: tests/api/auth.api.spec.ts › applies no rate limit or lockout to repeated failures
